messages.author: 565700a71b862c89
messages.subject: aov object types
parts:
Michael,

First, thanks for writing the ezANOVA package. It's been immensely
helpful.

I've used the ezANOVA to analyze data from a within subjects
experiment. After setting return_aov equal to true, I was hoping to
use the outputted aov type object in the stepAIC function in the MASS
package. I know now that we receive a "aovlist" "listof" type object
upon setting return_aov to true in the ezANOVA function. I have two
questions for you, and these may be naive given my lack of experience
with aov objects:

(1) Is there a way to extract from the "aovlist" "listof" type object
an "aov" object? This would then serve as input for the stepAIC
function.
(2) If not, can you recommend another model selection function that
can use the output of ezANOVA?

Separately, after setting detailed = TRUE, I haven't been able to see
an AIC value. Are there cases where this commonly happens?

Thanks!

Ansu

messages.author: 0e0df690b737d734
messages.subject: Re: aov object types
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm actually struggling with exactly the same thing: how to invoke the
aov supposedly returned by ezANOVA. I just fail to figure it out.
It would be hugely useful to see an example of how to make use of the
aov returned by ezANOVA. Something like that would be greatly
appreciated by the non-programmers

And big thank you to Michael for the ez package
DJP
